description: This file defines a jQuery plugin for alert progress dialogs, including functions to show and hide progress windows with optional timeout and callback features.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Displays a progress dialog with a message, optional timeout, and callback.

methods.name: _show
methods.description: Internal method to display the progress dialog with specified parameters.

methods.name: _hide
methods.description: Internal method to close the progress dialog.

methods.name: _overlay
methods.description: Manages the overlay background for dialogs, showing or hiding it.

methods.name: _reposition
methods.description: Repositions the dialog to the center of the window.

methods.name: _maintainPosition
methods.description: Attaches or detaches window resize event handlers to maintain dialog position.
